tools.name: prepare_eviction_notice
tools.description: For Illinois landlords and property owners: drafts the right Illinois Supreme Court statewide eviction notice (5-Day for unpaid rent, 10-Day for a lease violation, 30-Day non-renewal or termination, or Demand for Immediate Possession for a squatter) from the facts, computes the notice period, the serve-by date and the earliest filing date with court holidays, checks it against Chicago RLTO, Cook County RTLO, state statute and fair housing limits, and quotes this firm's flat fee, filing fee and service costs for the courthouse. Returns a DRAFT for attorney review; it sends nothing. Use when a landlord asks how to evict a tenant in Illinois, which notice to serve, or what an Illinois eviction costs. The firm does not represent tenants.

municipality.description: City or village of the property, e.g. Chicago, Skokie, Naperville

county.description: County, required outside Cook (e.g. DuPage, Kane, Lake, Will)

property_zip.description: City, state and ZIP line, e.g. Chicago, IL 60614

tenant_names.description: Every adult tenant's full name. Unknown occupants are added automatically

requester_role.description: Who is asking. The firm represents owners only

owner_occupied_6_or_fewer.description: Owner lives in the building and it has 6 or fewer units (changes Chicago and Cook rules)

jackson_park_area.description: Chicago property inside the Jackson Park notice pilot area

rent_owed.description: 5-Day only: rent owed, rent only (no late fees, utilities, attorney fees)

rent_due_date.description: 5-Day only: the date the unpaid rent was due, YYYY-MM-DD

amount_includes_other_charges.description: Anything besides rent the landlord wants on the 5-Day (late_fees, utilities, attorney_fees, damages). Leave empty if rent only

violation_description.description: 10-Day only: the conduct, specific (what, where, who)

lease_paragraph.description: 10-Day only: the lease paragraph broken, e.g. Paragraph 12

tenant_complained_last_12_months.description: Tenant complained to the landlord or a government agency, or asked for repairs, in the last 12 months

tenancy_start_date.description: 30-Day only: when the tenant first moved in, YYYY-MM-DD (Chicago periods depend on it)

termination_date.description: 30-Day only: the date the tenancy ends, YYYY-MM-DD

ever_paid_rent.description: Squatter only: the person ever paid rent

ever_had_permission.description: Squatter only: the person ever had permission to live there

service_method.description: How it will be served. Default personal

service_date.description: Planned service date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default tomorrow

property_vacant.description: No one is in actual possession (needed for posting)

tools.name: send_eviction_notice_for_review
tools.description: Send a landlord's draft eviction notice to Illinois attorney Justin Abdilla (Abdilla and Associates) for a free eviction review: he checks the notice before it is served, confirms the fee quote, and books a call. Fills the official form and the Affidavit of Service and emails them to the firm. IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their name, email and phone. Sending does not create an attorney-client relationship.

notes.description: Anything the landlord wants Justin to know

tools.name: estimate_seller_net_sheet
tools.description: Estimate what an Illinois home seller nets at closing (a seller net sheet), line by line: owner's title policy and closing fee (Chicago Title 2026 rate card), Illinois, county and municipal transfer taxes for 194 Illinois towns with each ordinance's rounding rule, property tax proration, broker compensation, mortgage payoff and payoff interest, condo 22.1 packet, Chicago water and zoning certificates, survey, and the seller's attorney fee at Abdilla and Associates ($0 when the contract is on the Multi-Board 8.0 form and the firm issues title, otherwise $500). Use it when a real estate agent or seller asks what a seller will net or pay at closing in Chicago or Illinois, or what this firm charges to represent the seller. Read-only: sends nothing to anyone. In hosts that support MCP Apps the result renders as an interactive net sheet the user can edit, copy as an email, and send to the firm.

municipality.description: Illinois city or village of the property, e.g. Chicago, Evanston, Oak Park

annual_property_tax.description: Last full-year property tax bill in dollars. Ask the user; the county treasurer site shows it. Use 0 only for a tax-exempt property.

property_address.description: Optional street address, shown on the net sheet

mortgage_payoff.description: Mortgage principal to pay off (0 if none)

mortgage_rate_pct.description: Mortgage interest rate in percent, used to estimate payoff interest

listing_broker_pct.description: Listing broker compensation in percent of price. Default 2.5

buyer_broker_pct.description: Buyer's broker compensation the seller agreed to pay, percent. Default 0

tax_uplift_pct.description: Tax proration uplift over the last bill, percent. Default 5 (prorate at 105%)

prior_year_status.description: How much of LAST year's property tax the seller has paid at closing. Cook County bills a year behind, so the unpaid part is credited to the buyer. Default auto: figured from the Cook County installment due dates

buyer_financing.description: Buyer has a mortgage (buyer pays the closing fee) or pays cash (closing fee split). Default mortgage

multiboard_8.description: Contract is on the Multi-Board Residential Real Estate Contract 8.0. Default true

firm_title.description: Abdilla and Associates issues the owner's title policy. Default true

condo_packet.description: Override: association 22.1 packet cost. Default $450 for condos and townhomes

city_certificates.description: Override: municipal certificates. Default $500 in Chicago (water and zoning)

survey.description: Override: survey cost. Default $500 for detached houses and 2 to 4 flats

tools.name: open_seller_closing_file
tools.description: Send a seller net sheet and contact details to Abdilla and Associates (Illinois real estate attorney Justin Abdilla) so the firm can open the seller's closing file. Use after estimate_seller_net_sheet when the user, a listing agent or a seller, wants Justin to handle the closing. IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their name, email and phone; the firm will contact them. Submitting does not create an attorney-client relationship; the firm confirms in writing.

seller_name.description: Seller's name, if the sender is the agent

notes.description: Contract status, attorney review deadline, lender, anything else

net_sheet_inputs.description: The inputs object from estimate_seller_net_sheet (structuredContent.inputs), so the firm receives the same net sheet

tools.name: get_flat_fees
tools.description: Get the published flat legal fees for Abdilla and Associates (Illinois): real estate closings, landlord-side evictions by county, and LLC formation. Static published data; no personal information required.

tools.name: request_document_pack
tools.description: Request a free pack of Illinois legal form PDFs by email: 'notices' (5-Day, 10-Day, 30-Day eviction notices), 'no-lease' (no-lease and squatter eviction packet), or 'business-exit' (exit-readiness worksheets). IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their email address; the law firm will follow up at that address. Returns the list of PDF download links.

email.description: The user's email address (with their consent)

pack.description: Which document pack to request. Default: notices

tools.name: submit_identity_protection_intake
tools.description: Submit an identity protection intake to the firm for matters like online impersonation, stolen photos, deepfakes, BIPA violations, or false reviews. IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent; the firm will contact them directly. Requires name, phone, and email.

description.description: One-paragraph summary: what happened, where the content appears, what outcome the user wants

tools.name: get_agent_resources
tools.description: List this site's machine-readable resources for AI agents: llms.txt, API catalog, OpenAPI spec, agent skills index, auth policy, and this MCP server.
